# mookoop

> An open-source, client-first studio for designing App Store and Google Play screenshots and banners.

## Overview
mookoop (https://mookoop.studio) is a free web-based design tool built for mobile developers and designers. It generates pixel-perfect, compliant screenshots and Google Play Feature Graphics without requiring accounts or uploading sensitive images to external servers.

## Key Features
- **App Store & Google Play Formats**: Preconfigured canvas dimensions for iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPad Pro 13", Android phones, Apple Watch, and Mac.
- **Google Play Feature Graphic (1024x500)**: Interactive 3D tilt, device repositioning, custom scaling, and badges.
- **Opaque 24-bit PNG Export**: Guaranteed zero alpha channel to strictly adhere to App Store Connect and Google Play Console upload requirements.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Renders directly in the browser using HTML5 Canvas. No server-side storage of user images.
- **Open Source**: MIT licensed Next.js application.
